Filter for payments included in a specific payout.

The payout ID is returned in the `id` property of the [List Payouts](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/api-reference/get-treasury-list-payouts#response.items) and [Retrieve Payout](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/api-reference/get-treasury-payout#response.id) responses. Use this filter to find the payments included in a deposit to your external bank account.

For example, `?payoutId=pyt_db6675c5-7b07-4af9-8c68-a54a336d2911` returns the payments included in this payout.

parameters.description:
Filter for payments from a specific check deposit.

For example, `?checkDepositId=chk_7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d` returns the payments from this check deposit.
parameters.name: checkDepositId

parameters.description:
Filter for check payments with a specific check number.

For example, `?checkNumber=10482` returns check payments with the check number `10482`.
parameters.name: checkNumber

schema.description:
Filter for check payments with a specific check number.

For example, `?checkNumber=10482` returns check payments with the check number `10482`.

parameters.description:
Filter for payments with a specific status. Can be:
 - `PENDING`: Your Stedi Treasury account received the inbound ACH transfer or check deposit and is waiting for the funds to settle.
 - `SETTLED`: Your Stedi Treasury account received the inbound transfer or check deposit, and the funds are available.
 - `FAILED`: The bank returned, rejected, or canceled the transfer.

For example, `?status=PENDING` returns payments whose funds haven't settled yet.

ListPayments_example2.description: Filters combine, so this returns only the payments for one billing entity that are `SETTLED`.
ListPayments_example2.summary: List payments for a billing entity

parameters.name: status

parameters.description:
Filter for payments with a specific Automated Clearing House (ACH) trace number. The trace number must be exactly 15 digits.

For example, `?achTraceNumber=021000021234567` returns the payment with this trace number.
parameters.name: achTraceNumber

schema.description:
Filter for payments with a specific Automated Clearing House (ACH) trace number. The trace number must be exactly 15 digits.

For example, `?achTraceNumber=021000021234567` returns the payment with this trace number.

parameters.description:
Filter for payments with a specific reassociation trace number.

The reassociation trace number matches the trace number in the payment's 835 Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA):
 - **JSON:** [`transactions[].paymentAndRemitReassociationDetails.checkOrEFTTraceNumber`](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/api-reference/get-healthcare-reports-835#response.transactions.paymentAndRemitReassociationDetails.checkOrEFTTraceNumber)
 - **X12 EDI:** `TRN02` (Check or EFT Trace Number)

For example, `?reassociationTraceNumber=REASSO456` returns the payment for the ERA with the trace number `REASSO456`.
parameters.name: reassociationTraceNumber

schema.description:
Filter for payments with a specific reassociation trace number.

The reassociation trace number matches the trace number in the payment's 835 Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA):
 - **JSON:** [`transactions[].paymentAndRemitReassociationDetails.checkOrEFTTraceNumber`](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/api-reference/get-healthcare-reports-835#response.transactions.paymentAndRemitReassociationDetails.checkOrEFTTraceNumber)
 - **X12 EDI:** `TRN02` (Check or EFT Trace Number)

For example, `?reassociationTraceNumber=REASSO456` returns the payment for the ERA with the trace number `REASSO456`.

parameters.description:
Filter for payments with a specific transaction purpose.

If you don't include this parameter, the results don't include `VERIFICATION` transactions, which are small deposits that payers send to verify a bank account.

For example, `?transactionPurpose=VERIFICATION` returns only verification transactions.

ListPayments_example4.description: The results include `VERIFICATION` transactions only when you filter for them with `transactionPurpose`.

get.description: Retrieves a payment, including its status, amount, and transaction details

parameters.description: The unique identifier for the payment you want to retrieve, in the format `pay_` followed by a UUID. You can retrieve payment IDs with the [List Payments](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/api-reference/get-treasury-list-payments) endpoint.

GetPayment_example2.description: This transfer is scheduled to settle on a future date, so `settlement.schedule` is `FUTURE_DATED` and `settlement.expectedFundsSettlementAt` is in the future. `audit` only contains `pendingAt` until the funds arrive.

GetPayment_example3.description: A payment moves to `FAILED` when the bank returns, rejects, or cancels the transfer. This can happen at any point in the lifecycle, so `audit` can contain `failedAt` alongside earlier timestamps.

GetPayment_example4.description: Payments from a check deposit contain `transaction.check` instead of `transaction.ach`, and have no ACH trace number or settlement schedule. The `reassociationTraceNumber` is the check number.

GetPayment_example5.description: Once the check's deposit hold releases and the funds settle, Stedi sets `audit.settledAt` and initiates a payout for the payment.

GetPayment_example6.description: Stedi returns `NotFoundException` when no payment has this identifier.

parameters.description:
Filter for payouts with a specific status. Can be:
 - `PENDING`: Stedi submitted a request to transfer the funds to the external bank account.
 - `IN_TRANSIT`: Stedi's banking partner has begun transferring the funds to the external bank account.
 - `PAID_OUT`: The funds have been successfully transferred to the external bank account.
 - `FAILED`: The bank returned, rejected, or canceled the transfer.

For example, `?status=IN_TRANSIT` returns payouts that Stedi's banking partner has begun transferring to the external bank account.

get.description: Retrieves a payout, including its status, amount, and ACH transfer details

parameters.description: The unique identifier for the payout you want to retrieve, in the format `pyt_` followed by a UUID. You can retrieve payout IDs with the [List Payouts](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/api-reference/get-treasury-list-payouts) endpoint.

GetPayout_example1.description: A payout is `PENDING` once Stedi submits a request to transfer the funds. Stedi adds `transaction.ach.submission` at submission, and `acknowledgment` and `settlement` aren't present yet.

GetPayout_example2.description: Once the funds have been transferred to the external bank account, the payout is `PAID_OUT` and contains `submission`, `acknowledgment`, and `settlement` details.

GetPayout_example3.description: A payout moves to `FAILED` when the bank returns, rejects, or cancels the transfer. This can happen at any point, so `audit` keeps the earlier timestamps and `settlement` is absent.

GetPayout_example4.description: Stedi returns `NotFoundException` when no payout has this identifier.
